page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m2.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.u2i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs clocked at 2.7 GHz and is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions the instance as a compute-focused resource.

The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high CPU allocation relative to memory capacity, avoiding the overhead of unneeded local storage or memory overhead.

Suitable workloads for this configuration include compute-heavy tasks that do not demand massive memory footprints, such as web serving, batch processing, application servers, and distributed microservices.
